fields.label: County code
fields.description: Province ISO code + a 3-digit index of the county within its province (by English name). Not an official code.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Area of the OpenStreetMap county outline (equal-area projection).

fields.label: Growth 2006–2016
fields.description: Population change between the 2006 and 2016 censuses. Null where the county was split or created in between, or Wikidata has no 2006 figure.

fields.label: GDP (estimate)
fields.description: The province's 2016 GDP split by the county's share of its population.

fields.label: Forest
fields.description: Share of land that is tree cover.

fields.label: Cropland
fields.description: Share of land that is cropland.

fields.label: Pasture
fields.description: Share of land that is pasture.

fields.label: Built-up
fields.description: Share of land that is built-up.

fields.label: City
fields.description: The id of the largest city in the county, when it is in cities.json.

fields.label: Map cell
fields.description: A representative land hex of the county.
